title: ZUULI
fullDescription:
ZUULI is a self-custody Zcash wallet from 2Z Inc.

Create or restore a wallet from a recovery phrase, sync against a lightwalletd server, receive to a unified address, review a transaction before you sign it, and send shielded ZEC. Your recovery phrase and spending keys stay on your device; ZUULI never renders remote articles, media, or third-party embeds beside them.

You can sign in with a Free2Z account to prove a Zcash address you control, and you can buy 2Z credits. 2Z credits are separate from Zcash and are used for eligible Free2Z experiences.

This preview is distributed only to approved internal testers. Use only small amounts you can afford to lose during internal testing, and report unexpected wallet, sign-in, payment, or accessibility behavior through the support channel.
releaseNotes: Internal preview: exercise wallet create/restore, sync, receive, send review, history, sign-in, payment, and accessibility flows. Use only small amounts you can afford to lose during internal testing.
